_comment: Single source of truth for the RV trip structure. Both index.html (via itinerary.js) and weather.html (via weather.js) read from this. The Python data-fetch scripts also read this for the sleep STOPS list. Weather/rain data lives in separate generated files (weather-data.json, rain-data.json) keyed by day number. EVERY value has provenance metadata — see rv/assets/META.md and the PROVENANCE RULES in rv/CLAUDE.md before editing.

The drives list always represents real travel between distinct stop coords.
